champion_bridge: computational geometry + software verification -> deterministic encounter queue with round-trip trust reporting
iteration_notes: Validation feedback pushes the search away from broad simulator claims and toward a narrow audit-and-honesty thesis.
Smooth controls are already acceptable for the direct kernel; close encounters remain the highest-leverage failure regime.
Large-N performance, classroom packaging, and exact reversibility now create more novelty risk than upside.
Offline calibration stays in reserve only if it yields transparent presets that remain ordered on held-out scenes.
feedback_digest: The falsifier says the easiest rejection is textbook reimplementation or a small-REBOUND clone unless claims stay narrow and auditable.
The novelty report says the real comparators are REBOUND, TRACE, JANUS, poliastro, and PhET, so keyword-collision literature can no longer anchor the story.
The benchmark report shows the direct kernel is fine on smooth controls but fails badly on star-grazing two-body, while encounter_microstep materially reduces that failure.
The citation audit passes, so the remaining risk is not missing citations but overreaching beyond the measured evidence.
